reason: Evidence shows this is a user-facing chat workflow plugin: it lets users edit a previously sent message, generate a new forked reply branch, and manage the resulting archived source session from settings, implemented through DSH host/client remote extension points rather than external tooling.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek 对话提供“编辑并重发”操作，可对已发送消息进行修改后重生成回复，并在设置中列出/恢复归档会话。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an edit-and-resend workflow for DeepSeek conversations, allowing a sent user message to be revised and regenerated via a new branch, with archived source sessions available for restore from Settings.

capabilities: Adds a button on completed chat turns to edit and resend messages
Reads turn text from host event logs to seed regenerated responses
Creates forked child sessions for resend workflow
Archives original sessions and restores them via settings UI
Exposes multiple host remote operations for edit/getText/archive/unarchive/listArchived

reasons.code: The plugin is documented as creating a new conversation branch by locating the target turn in a full event log and invoking a fork-and-followup flow (`edit`, `agents.create`), then updating session state.
It injects UI into `conversation.chat.turnTail` and `settings.section` via client slots and calls host remote methods to perform edit/resend/archiving actions.
It intentionally archives source sessions after resend and provides an unarchive/restore list in settings, which changes visible session state without deleting data.
